sourceStatus: literature-constrained procedural assets; not field-calibrated reconstruction

physics.leaves: bounded quasi-static strip bending for explicit petiolate blades
physics.rootSoil: root topology and relative soil response illustration, no hydraulic or anchorage solver
physics.woodLoads: actual rendered tube sections include merged fine shoots; nearest-owner lumping, circular/polygon-frustum approximation
physics.unsolved: off-axis torsion, root-soil compliance, fracture and full nonlinear beam response

growthRules.scaffold: persistent without an explicit pruning/damage event
growthRules.rootJunction: actual shoot collar joined to generated root crown
growthRules.roots: keyed axis identities and fixed material-node prefixes; proximal seed-to-collar extension
growthRules.foliation: fixed seasonal foliation-site identities and reserved cohort slots; no age-only evictions

visualRefinement.osmanthus: irregular connected dense 3D crown; straight-axis approximation
visualRefinement.camphorAcer: fixed curved material axes with parent-tangent-oriented descendants
visualRefinement.iris: ribbed fans, curved falls, white fringed crests and procedural vein pigment
visualRefinement.herbRoots: shared active ramets, actual surface-node root starts and basal bridges
